items.title: Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) Pattern
items.description: A comprehensive guide to the Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) pattern in asynchronous messaging, outlining poison pill handling, visibility timeouts, AWS SQS, Spring Boot/Kafka/RabbitMQ configs, and production playbooks.

items.title: Load Balancing & Service Reliability
items.description: Load balancing algorithms, health checks, failover strategies, chaos engineering, disaster recovery, and SRE practices for building reliable distributed services.
